bibl.title: A Christian Funerary Inscription for Phebronia in the Magazine at Fustât (Old Cairo)
bibl.seg: Lincoln H. Blumell & Amer El Mesiry, A Christian Funerary Inscription for Phebronia in the Magazine at Fustât (Old Cairo).
bibl.note: Edition of a Christian funerary inscription in Greek for a woman named Phebronia (provenance unknown, March 12, VI-VIIIp). The inscription is unique since it contains an elaborate literary tribute to the deceased that is largely unparalleled.
